request.provenance: Codex self-review of current Task 005 S1 execution; not independent review

findings.title: A refreshed product range or older page conflicts with an existing Android segment
findings.evidence: src/services/codexHistoryProductProvider.js:135 includes the already cached anchor in every older page; src/services/codexHistorySyncService.js:1236 upserts all page items. A detail-only change produces a new contentHash/range.segmentId. android/app/src/main/java/com/termlink/app/codex/data/CodexConversationCacheStore.kt:1287-1293 throws for changed hash from a different segment and for unchanged overlap from any non-legacy segment. CodexViewModel.kt:10136 sends that page unchanged to applyDeltaPage and maps the throw to REJECTED.
findings.consequence: After a first product_db tail is cached, older pagination and a later detail-only tail refresh can fail atomically; the new Node root/upsert cannot reach the Android cache.
findings.recommendation: Define an idempotent overlap/refresh rule preserving segment ownership and truthful anchors, then add a real cache commit/reopen regression for both older overlap and changed detail refs.

findings.title: Complete server-snapshot cache bypasses the product DB-first request
findings.evidence: android/app/src/main/java/com/termlink/app/codex/CodexViewModel.kt:8431-8483 returns from maybeRequestHistorySync for a complete local cache or complete server_snapshot cache before it sends the newly dual-capability history request at line 8626. Product DB precedence in src/ws/terminalGateway.js:7570+ only applies when that request arrives.
findings.consequence: An existing device with a complete snapshot can remain on its old static projection and never receive a newly published product_db row or its detail refs on selection; current DB-first acceptance is not established.
findings.recommendation: Preserve cache-first rendering and live IPC authority while providing a bounded product DB reconciliation request for this selection; test a pre-existing complete snapshot cache transitioning to a product row.

findings.title: Old Android clients still reject product pages carrying detail metadata
findings.evidence: src/services/codexHistorySyncService.js:409-411 always sends detailRefs/truncation/availability regardless cache schema. Before this S1 change, Android CodexWireModels.kt discarded those fields; its page hasher reconstructed a wire item without them and CodexConversationCacheStore.kt:975 rejects a differing page hash. With the checked-in product fixture the wire hash is 6b95178c..., while dropping the three fields yields d237a4f5....
findings.consequence: The plan's old-client compatibility claim is unsupported for product rows with detail refs or availability; legacy app versions cannot commit those pages.
findings.recommendation: Specify and implement version/capability handling for older clients or explicitly narrow the compatibility claim through an informed plan change; verify the older wire path.

coverage.subject: Exact Task 005 S1 worktree revision above; product, Android, tests and product contract reviewed.
coverage.validated: Read-only code/call-chain review, recorded Node 19/19 product flow and 139/139 Owner/IPC results, Android 193 JVM results, Android instrumentation compile, cross-version page-hash comparison.
limits: No tests were rerun for this review.
Android SQLite migration/reopen instrumentation test was compiled but not executed on a device.
No real external host or physical Android E2E; planned S2.
The existing Task 004 supplemental review remains unassociated and is unrelated to this verdict.
